_comment: Smoke-test config demonstrating the new player-type schema. The DT player loads a pickled ID3 tree (path resolved relative to the project root) and the Random player needs no fields beyond its type. Backwards compat: omitting 'type' still defaults to 'mcts' so every pre-existing tournament JSON keeps working. Real DT-vs-MCTS configs live alongside this file under scripts/tournament_configs/.
